title: Help Measures for Households and Businesses Given Continued Rise in Food and Fuel Prices
what_it_is: Help Measures for Households and Businesses Given Continued Rise in Food and Fuel Prices

sections.label: CPI-All Items inflation fall
sections.summary: CPI-All Items inflation fell to 4.1% year-on-year in July, from 6.6% in January.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Consumer Price Index (CPI)-All Items inflation fell to 4.1% on a year-on-year basis in July, from 6.6% in January.

sections.label: MTI and MAS inflation forecasts
sections.summary: MTI expects CPI-All Items inflation to average 4.5% to 5.5% for the full year, while MAS Core Inflation is projected at 3.5% to 4.5%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: For the full year, the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) expects CPI-All Items inflation to average 4.5% to 5.5%, while the MAS Core Inflation is projected to be 3.5% to 4.5%.

sections.label: Assurance Package Budget 2023 payouts
sections.summary: The Assurance Package in Budget 2023 provided a Cost-of-Living Special Payment of $200 to $400 and additional CDC Vouchers for eligible Singaporean households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: For example, the Assurance Package in Budget 2023 provided a Cost-of-Living Special Payment of between $200 and $400 and additional Community Development Council (CDC) Vouchers for eligible Singaporean households.

sections.label: Global rice prices rise
sections.summary: Global rice prices rose due to India's ban on non-basmati white rice exports and adverse weather, with the FAO All Rice Price Index up 31.2% in August year-on-year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Global rice prices, in fact, have risen in recent months because of India's ban on the export of non-basmati white rice and, of course, adverse weather conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, if you look at the Food and Agriculture Organization's (FAO) All Rice Price Index, it has increased by 31.2% in August year-on-year.

sections.label: Inflation by income group
sections.summary: CPI-All Items inflation was 4.9% for the lowest 20 percentile, 5.6% for the middle 60%, and 5.9% for the highest 20% income group.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The CPI-All Items Inflation for the lowest 20 percentile and the middle 60% income groups came at 4.9% and 5.6% year-on-year respectively, compared to 5.9% year-on year for the highest 20% income group.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Nonetheless, we are also aware that this same level of inflation can have a more adverse impact on lower-income households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I think both Minister Tan See Leng as well as Minister of State Chee Hong Tat have already explained as per in my reply how we are particularly helping the lower-income group through higher payouts, for example, in the Assurance Packages and the Good and Services Tax (GST) Voucher schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With regard to the energy prices, global demand for oil is expected to moderate, given the ongoing global economic slowdown and also China's slower than expected economic recovery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But despite coming off their peaks last year, global oil prices are expected to remain elevated in 2023 because of tightened supply constraints.

sections.label: MAS October monetary policy review
sections.summary: MAS will review this stance at the next monetary policy meeting in October.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, MAS will review this stance in the next monetary policy meeting in October.
